Issue: Word Journey shows '0 words tracked' and the empty state even after real flash sessions. SessionLogTracker writes daily_tracking.flashcard_id as "<card uuid>:R<round>" (to dodge the user_id/flashcard_id/date unique index), but six screens join that column against a bare flashcards.id, so the lookup never matches and every card scores flashCount 0. Fixed by normalising with a shared cardIdFrom() helper (splits on ':'). Also affects Flashed Words Grid, Bingo Card Generator, Weekly Word Planner, All Words, and Calendar Grid View. Flashed History and the dashboard were unaffected because they never join to flashcards.
